color_palette.background: Leave as is. Fills Page › Background, the color behind every section of every page. The Tangent text colors are made for white.
color_palette.foreground: Leave as is. A navy from an earlier design. Only parts Horizon draws itself use it; the Tangent blocks use their own near-black.
color_palette.color1: Leave as is. Fills Typography › Text, the default color of text that has no Tangent style.
color_palette.color2: Leave as is. The light line color of Horizon's drawers, pop-ups and option buttons.
